Production.description: A production with its attribute equations

Production with condition.description: A production used only when a condition holds, with a weight

Attribute.description: An inherited attribute, passed down whole (copy) or divided among children (split)

Synthesized attribute.description: An attribute computed from the children

Random value.description: A value drawn once per question

Let.description: A value computed from randoms and other lets

Import.description: Use another file's nonterminals, values and questions under an alias

Prompt and answer.description: The question text and the value it is graded against

Answer blank.description: An answer blank inside a prompt

Question.description: A named question in this file

Set.description: A whole assignment built from questions

Set part.description: A headed part of a set
